class.name: NextGeoTestBridge
class.description: Editor-only helper for the virtual geometry round trip. Lightmap baking is not exposed to scripts, so this class calls it.

method.name: bake_lightmap
method.description: Bakes [param lightmap] starting at [param from_node] and writes the image data to [param image_data_path], which must be a resource path. Returns a [enum LightmapGI.BakeError] value. If EditorSettings or EditorPaths is missing, the bake is not started and the return is LightmapGI.BAKE_ERROR_NO_LIGHTMAPPER.
